When you tap Translate with AI, the text you chose (up to %1$d characters) is sent over the internet to our server, which passes it to an AI service to produce the translation. Nothing is sent until you tap Translate, and nothing is sent from password fields. Our server does not store your text; it keeps only a daily count for this install to limit usage. Translating on your phone sends nothing. You can withdraw your consent here at any time.
